## Installation

<docs.Tabs sync="install">
<docs.TabItem label="CLI">

Run the command in the app module.

```sh frame="terminal" title="Terminal"
gx add aspect-ratio
```

The command writes these files.

| File | Path in the app |
| --- | --- |
| `AspectRatio.gx` | `ui/aspect-ratio/AspectRatio.gx` |
| `AspectRatio.fixtures.go` | `ui/aspect-ratio/AspectRatio.fixtures.go` |
| `styles.go` | `ui/aspect-ratio/styles.go` |

</docs.TabItem>
<docs.TabItem label="Manual">

Copy each file to its path in the app. Change each import of a registry package to the path of that package in the app.

```gx title="ui/aspect-ratio/AspectRatio.gx"
package aspectratio

props {
  // Ratio is the CSS aspect-ratio value, width over height, for example 4 / 3. An empty value is
  // 16 / 9.
  Ratio    string = "16 / 9"
  // Class adds classes to the root element.
  Class    string = ""
  // Children is the content of the box, for example an image.
  Children gx.Node
  // Attrs adds HTML attributes to the root element.
  Attrs    gx.Attrs = nil
}

<div data-slot="aspect-ratio" style={gx.Style("aspect-ratio: " + p.ratio())} class={gx.Cx("relative w-full overflow-hidden", p.Class)} {...p.Attrs}>{p.Children}</div>
```

```go title="ui/aspect-ratio/AspectRatio.fixtures.go"
package aspectratio

import "github.com/alternayte/gx"

var AspectRatioFixtures = gx.Fixtures[AspectRatioProps]{
	"Wide":   {Ratio: "16 / 9", Class: "rounded-lg bg-muted", Children: gx.Text("16 / 9")},
	"Square": {Ratio: "1 / 1", Class: "max-w-40 rounded-lg bg-muted", Children: gx.Text("1 / 1")},
}
```

```go title="ui/aspect-ratio/styles.go"
package aspectratio

// ratio returns the CSS ratio; a zero value is 16 / 9.
func (p AspectRatioProps) ratio() string {
	if p.Ratio == "" {
		return "16 / 9"
	}
	return p.Ratio
}
```

</docs.TabItem>
</docs.Tabs>

## Usage

```gx
<aspectratio.AspectRatio ratio="16 / 9" class="rounded-lg bg-muted">
  <img src={gx.URL("/hero.jpg")} alt="Hero" class="size-full object-cover" />
</aspectratio.AspectRatio>
```

## API reference

A tag sets a prop by its name with a lower-case first letter: `Class` is `class`.

### aspectratio.AspectRatio

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Ratio` | `string` | `"16 / 9"` | Ratio is the CSS aspect-ratio value, width over height, for example 4 / 3. An empty value is 16 / 9. |
| `Class` | `string` | `""` | Class adds classes to the root element. |
| `Children` | `gx.Node` | Required | Children is the content of the box, for example an image. |
| `Attrs` | `gx.Attrs` | `nil` | Attrs adds HTML attributes to the root element. |

## Do and do not

<docs.CardGrid>
<docs.Card title="Do">

- Set `Ratio` as a CSS ratio, for example `16 / 9`.
- Let the child fill the box with `size-full`.

</docs.Card>
<docs.Card title="Don't">

- Do not use an aspect ratio for text content.
- Do not nest aspect ratio boxes.

</docs.Card>
</docs.CardGrid>
